name: Masala Chai
steps: Lightly crush the cardamom pods to expose their seeds. Put them in a saucepan with the cinnamon and measured water, using a pan with room for the milk to rise.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for about 2 minutes so the spices flavour the water. Keep the heat moderate rather than reducing the liquid rapidly.
Add black tea, milk and sugar and stir. Bring back to a gentle simmer, reducing the heat as soon as the milk begins to rise.
Simmer for 3–4 minutes, watching continuously to prevent boiling over. Stop earlier for a lighter cup; excessive boiling can make the tea bitter.
Turn off the heat and strain through a fine tea strainer into cups. Taste and adjust sweetness if needed, then serve hot.
tips: Adjust sugar and tea strength to taste.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
notes: Ingredient costs are estimates. Check local prices before shopping.
